title: Correct Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the force on the electron in the lab frame.

title: Correct Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the force on the electron in the electron's rest frame.

title: Magnetic Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the magnetic field produced by the wire using Ampère's law.

title: Lorentz Force Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Lorentz force equation to find the force on the electron in both frames.

title: Comparison of Forces
description: Important Criteria: The student should qualitatively compare the forces in both frames, discussing the nature of the forces involved.

title: Relativistic Effects Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the effects of relativistic corrections when transitioning between frames.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the calculations of forces.
